title: Daisy
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Daisy |image = Daisy.png |achievement = D.I.Y. |ad = [[Crafting|Craft]] 15 different items. |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Daisy''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}} after earning the "D.I.Y." [[Achievements|Achievement]] ([[Crafting|craft]] 15 different items). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Female players have a ≈2% chance to receive the outfit with the Daisy. ==Notes== * The Daisy outfit also includes a [[File:Shirt118.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 93,164,247). ==References== Female players have 48 possible outfits (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
